{{Quote|I just spoke with Raine last week. His unit was preparing to ship out to Ralltiir &mdash; some kind of local trouble, I suppose. I miss them all terribly, but especially Raine.''"<br />"''I guess that's natural &mdash; he is your twin brother, after all.|Celia Durasha and [[Adion Lang]]|<ref name="ACPOV" />}}
'''Raine Durasha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. His unit was deployed to [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] during the Imperial [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation of the world]]. Durasha was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when his unit was ambushed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces at the [[Grallia Spaceport|spaceport]] [[1 BBY/Legends|shortly before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ACPOV" />

He was the twin brother of [[Celia Durasha]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
